assessor: RTS implementation preflight — Model Transition Intelligence v1
rationale: Repository-local deterministic comparison of supplied immutable evidence bundles only. v1 has no crawler, provider/network calls, credentials, runtime routing mutation, hidden architecture inference, or automatic promotion. Official-document claims remain hypotheses; conflicting or incomplete evidence fails to REVIEW_REQUIRED/UNKNOWN; probe output is bounded by F's maximum probe dimensions and remains non-authorizing.
affected_boundaries: version evidence bundle and normalized contract-claim schema
old-profile disposition and bounded F/G probe request
existing_assumptions: F probe plans are bounded to max_probes <= 8 and advisory only.
G executes only explicitly approved bounded campaigns.
External documentation evidence does not create RTS Canon or execution authority.
Observed external contract != hidden internal neural architecture.

data_migration.notes: No existing profile, memory, FREEZER history, runtime router, or provider configuration is mutated.

approval_changes: none; H output grants no execution/profile-application/promotion authority
S3 may mark old operating assumptions DIRECT_APPLICATION_BLOCKED but cannot delete historical evidence or mutate runtime
hidden_dependencies: source provenance and content digest must be present for every evidence source
only official contract evidence can raise transition severity
conflicting official claims for the same contract key must remain REVIEW_REQUIRED
probe mapping must remain within F's controlled dimensions and max 8 probes
rollback_boundary: Drop the H branch or revert model_transition_intelligence files and FRZ-000018 append-only versions; A-G remain untouched.
completion_conditions: marketing-only or wording-only changes remain S0
limit/tuning changes map to S1 without architecture overclaim
behavioral contract changes map to S2 and targeted bounded probes
explicit execution-contract topology changes map to S3 and block direct old-profile application
documentation claims remain UNVERIFIED until observed evidence exists
conflicting official docs produce REVIEW_REQUIRED instead of false certainty
probe requests are deduplicated and capped at 8
A-H regressions and FREEZER verify pass
risks: normalized claim extraction is upstream of H v1; bad extraction can still create a bad hypothesis, so exact source pointers remain mandatory
classification rules are conservative and may require human review for ambiguous cross-document changes
S3 means observable execution-contract shift, not hidden neural architecture proof
